headline: MIN @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 3.76 at CHW 3.20, with a projected total of 6.97. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (MIN -1.24, CHW -1.25), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -2.49, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +20.0%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Davis Martin has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Munetaka Murakami, Brooks Lee, Luke Keaschall, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Victor Caratini, James Outman because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
